concepts.name: right ventricle
concepts.definition: The right ventricle is a cardiac chamber positioned predominantly anterior to the left ventricle.

concepts.name: myocardium
concepts.definition: The myocardium is cardiac muscle forming the ventricular wall and surrounding the left ventricular cavity.

concepts.name: left ventricle
concepts.definition: The left ventricle is a cardiac chamber bounded by the left ventricular myocardium.
